Name: Tired Harvey Reskin
Author: Hughskadoo
Description:
[size=3][b][center]While Pelican Town is small with an even smaller population, being the only doctor must take a toll [i]especially[/i] with medical bills up to his eyeballs.[/center][/b][/size]

While supposedly an "[i]older bachelor[/i]" I felt he could look older and more beaten up by the stresses of life. With a tasteful streak of grey in his hair and a raggedy appearance, I've also toned down his colour palette from the default vibrant colours to something quieter and I plan to do the same to the other townsfolk and buildings so he fits in more amongst everybody else. There are two options for the reskin, one file of him [b]without[/b] glasses, and one [b]with [/b]glasses. (You only need to download one or the other, choose whichever you'd prefer!) His glasses are a bit different, more towards an older age aesthetic.

He's [u]tired[/u], he's [u]stressed[/u], he's [u]seen more than he'd like to in the medical field[/u]. What more do you need? Perfect for players who enjoy the darker visual mods to give a more gothic feel, or players who like to build a world to roleplay in!

Files are labelled clearly, download which one you'd like in your town!
(((Please let me know of any issues with the mod, I'm very new to modding!)))
